title: Unit kummer two site normalization
statement:
Let $m\geq1$, $A$ a finite commutative ring with $mA=0$, and $X$ a scheme on which $m$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme]. On its small etale site use the unit sheaf $\mathbf G_m$, the roots $\mu_m=\ker([m]:\mathbf G_m\to\mathbf G_m)$, and the Kummer short exact sequence [lem-amb-kummer-any-base, def-sc-gm-torsor]. Write $\delta_X:\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)^\times\to H^1(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mu_m)$ for its right-derived-global-sections boundary [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor]. Put $L_X^{\mathrm{et}}=\mu_m^{\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/m}A_X$ and $L_X^{\mathrm{pro}}=\mu_m^{\mathrm{pro}}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/m}A_X$, with constant coefficients, sheaf tensors, comparison $\nu_X$, and cohomology of underlying abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf]. Let $c_X:\nu_X^{-1}\mu_m^{\mathrm{et}}\cong\mu_m^{\mathrm{pro}}$ be the same-root comparison [lem-amb-finite-root-site-comparison], and set $\varphi_X^{\mathrm{et}}(z)=z\otimes1_A$, $\varphi_X^{\mathrm{pro}}(z)=z\otimes1_A$. Define
$$\kappa_X^{\mathrm{et}}(u)=H^1(\varphi_X^{\mathrm{et}})\delta_X(u),\qquad \kappa_X^{\mathrm{pro}}(u)=H^1(\varphi_X^{\mathrm{pro}}c_X)\operatorname{comp}_X(\delta_X(u)),$$
where $\operatorname{comp}_X$ is the canonical etale-to-pro-etale cohomology comparison.

For units $u,w$ on $X$ and every $v:X'\to X$ one has, on both sites,
$$\kappa_X(uw)=\kappa_X(u)+\kappa_X(w),\qquad v^*\kappa_X(u)=\kappa_{X'}(v^*u),$$
under the canonical roots-and-tensor pullback identifications. The coefficient comparison $\nu_X^*L_X^{\mathrm{et}}\cong L_X^{\mathrm{pro}}$ sends $\kappa_X^{\mathrm{et}}(u)$ to exactly $\kappa_X^{\mathrm{pro}}(u)$ and intertwines these identities and geometric pullback. More precisely the morphism of ordinary Kummer sequences induced by pullback of units and roots gives $v^*\delta_X(u)=\delta_{X'}(v^*u)$, and the coefficient square with $z\mapsto z\otimes1_A$ commutes as a square of abelian sheaves.

For the finite purity datum $k,\ell,E,n,A$ of [def-pur-conventions] and $m=\ell^n$, the projection-induced identification $L_X^{\mathrm{pro}}\cong A_X(1)$ of [def-pur-frame-class] sends this class to the concrete $\kappa_X(u)$ prescribed there, for every $k$-scheme $X$ and every $n\geq1$. No freeness or flatness of $A$ over $\mathbf Z/m$, Cartier support, or tensor product of $\mathbf G_m$ over $\mathbf Z/m$ is assumed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-amb-kummer-any-base] with exponent $m$. The connecting map of [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor] is a morphism of abelian groups. Since the group law in $\mathbf G_m$ is multiplication, this gives $\delta_X(uw)=\delta_X(u)+\delta_X(w)$. The maps $H^1(\varphi_X^{\mathrm{et}})$, $\operatorname{comp}_X$ and $H^1(\varphi_X^{\mathrm{pro}}c_X)$ are homomorphisms: cohomology is a functor to abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and the comparison is the homomorphism of [lem-cbc-abelian-etale-proetale-cohomology-comparison]. Applying these homomorphisms to the displayed equality proves additivity on each site. The scalar insertion is constructed in Lean by the scalar-extension adjunction applied to the sheafification unit, followed by forgetting scalars; its component formula and natural-transformation extensionality prove the required unique specification.

Let $v:X'\to X$. The image of the inverse of $m$ is an inverse on $X'$, so [lem-amb-kummer-any-base] applies there too. Write $a:v_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}\mu_{m,X}\to\mu_{m,X'}$ and $b:v_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,X'}$ for pullback of roots and units; $a$ is the root isomorphism of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Pullback of units gives $b(z^m)=b(z)^m$, and $a$ is the restriction of $b$ to the kernel. Thus $(a,b,b)$ is a morphism from the inverse-image Kummer sequence to the Kummer sequence on $X'$. By [lem-weil-pbc-pullback-cohomology-long-exact-ladder], inverse image commutes with the degree-zero boundary; then naturality for morphisms of short exact sequences in [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor] gives
$$H^1(a)v_{\mathrm{et}}^*\delta_X(u)=\delta_{X'}\bigl(H^0(b)v_{\mathrm{et}}^*u\bigr)=\delta_{X'}(v^*u).$$
The last equality is [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero] followed by the defining pullback-of-units map $b$. In particular, $b$ need not be an isomorphism, and $\mathbf G_m$ is used only as an abelian sheaf.

proof.text:
Put $e:v_{\mathrm{et}}^*L_X^{\mathrm{et}}\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{X'}^{\mathrm{et}}$ for the root-tensor pullback of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. The square
$$e\,v_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}(\varphi_X^{\mathrm{et}})=\varphi_{X'}^{\mathrm{et}}a$$
commutes: on a local root $z$ both maps are $a(z)\otimes1_A$. This is a sheaf identity, since the maps are induced on presheaf tensors and then sheafified [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Pullback fixes the scalar section $1_A$. Naturality of cohomology pullback with respect to coefficient maps [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial] and Step 2 now give
$$H^1(e)v_{\mathrm{et}}^*\kappa_X^{\mathrm{et}}(u)=H^1(e\,v_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}\varphi_X^{\mathrm{et}})v_{\mathrm{et}}^*\delta_X(u)=\kappa_{X'}^{\mathrm{et}}(v^*u).$$
No short exact sequence has been tensored with $A$ in this argument.

proof.text:
Write $\sigma_X:\nu_X^*L_X^{\mathrm{et}}\cong L_X^{\mathrm{pro}}$ for [lem-amb-finite-root-site-comparison]. Its prescribed local formula $z\otimes a\mapsto z\otimes a$ gives the equality of abelian-sheaf morphisms
$$\sigma_X\nu_X^{-1}(\varphi_X^{\mathrm{et}})=\varphi_X^{\mathrm{pro}}c_X.$$
Apply the naturality in the coefficient sheaf of canonical cohomology pullback [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback](2) to $\nu_X$ and $\varphi_X^{\mathrm{et}}$. The isomorphism [lem-cbc-abelian-etale-proetale-cohomology-comparison] is this same canonical pullback. Thus, writing $C_X=H^1(\sigma_X)\operatorname{comp}_{X,L_X^{\mathrm{et}}}$,
$$C_X\kappa_X^{\mathrm{et}}(u)=H^1(\sigma_X\nu_X^{-1}\varphi_X^{\mathrm{et}})\operatorname{comp}_{X,\mu_m}\delta_X(u)=\kappa_X^{\mathrm{pro}}(u).$$
This also identifies the additive identities of Step 1, since $C_X$ is a homomorphism.

proof.text:
Finally take the datum of [def-pur-conventions] and $m=\ell^n$. The identification in [def-pur-frame-class] is $\theta_X:A(1)_X\cong L_X^{\mathrm{pro}}$, and that definition prescribes the map from roots as $\theta_X^{-1}\varphi_X^{\mathrm{pro}}$. Its map $\rho_X$ sends a root to the identical root, hence is $c_X$ by the same-root characterization in [lem-amb-finite-root-site-comparison]. Consequently
$$H^1(\theta_X^{-1})\kappa_X^{\mathrm{pro}}(u)=H^1(\theta_X^{-1}\varphi_X^{\mathrm{pro}}\rho_X)\operatorname{comp}_X\delta_X(u),$$
which is exactly the concrete formula defining $\kappa_X(u)$ there. The hypotheses hold for every $k$-scheme: $\ell\ne p$ makes $m$ invertible, and $\ell\in(\varpi_E)$ implies $\ell^nA=0$. This substitution uses the given projection-induced identification and imposes no flatness or Cartier condition.
